Backend: 80 of 81 pytest pass (70/71 in the earlier suites plus 10/10 in the new test_phase5_assets.py). The 1 failure is flaky: test_slow_within_budget under xdist load (latency 4389 ms > 4200); it passed 3 of 3 times when run alone. minor.issue: Flaky: test_slow_within_budget failed once under the parallel suite (latency_ms 4389 > 4200). It passed 3 of 3 times when run alone. Likely server contention under xdist.

integration_issues.issue: In 1 of 2 natural storm runs only 4 'tick' entries were logged (5 in the other). Ticks fire only when the store's integer countdown changes, and the 100 ms setInterval in useStormDirector can skip an integer if the main thread stalls for over 1 s (heavy software-GL frames in headless). Fix: in audio.js, when countdown jumps (for example 5 -> 3), emit a tick for each skipped value between p.countdown and s.countdown (bounded to 1..5), or schedule all 5 ticks on the audio clock when the countdown starts.

sfx() pushes the log entry before the 70 ms same-name throttle. Throttled calls therefore stay played:false even with SFX on: 36 of 42 firework entries were played:false in the finale. This contradicts the documented 'played:false means SFX are muted'. Fix: don't log throttled calls, or add a throttled:true flag.

issues: document.title stays 'FA CHE 花車: The Flower Float'. Set it to 'FA CHE 花車: Gameplay video' on the demo route. The page heading is already correct.

action_items: audio.js: emit the missing ticks when the countdown skips integers, so there are always 5 ticks
audio.js: don't mark throttled SFX as played:false (or add a throttled flag), so the log matches the documented meaning
DemoPage.jsx: set document.title to 'FA CHE 花車: Gameplay video' (and restore it when leaving)
Optional: loosen the 4200 ms upper bound in test_slow_within_budget, or run it outside xdist
critical_code_review_comments: generate_characters.py with --only rewrites last_run.results with only the listed ids, so earlier results for other characters are lost. Merge with the previous last_run.results instead.
generate_characters.py: on HTTP 401/402 the remaining ids are skipped; other errors continue. That is fine, but a 429 rate limit would just fail each character; consider retry with backoff.
ribbonTiming with force_fallback is still a network round trip (809 ms here), close to the 1000 ms bar. Consider using data.owners[owner].ribbon_fallback locally when force_fallback is on.
The audio sync() runs on every store change (subscribe without a selector). That is cheap now, but use subscribeWithSelector or compare relevant keys only.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of journeys pass; 2 minor audio-log robustness issues

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=...; pytest /app/backend/tests. test_phase5_assets.py runs a dry run of the Meshy script (no write). To inspect GLB characters in the scene, patch Object3D.prototype.updateMatrixWorld from window.__fache.store.getState().models.kit's prototype chain and collect objects named 'glb-character'. The skip-cinematic button can disappear while clicking right as a fly ends; use store.getState().skip() for reliability. A natural storm takes about 27 s; capture the audio log after beat leaves 'storm'.
